name: Radar chart
oneLiner: a frosted glass disc opens with a five-spoke web etched into it and the skills around its edge, a grey shape grows to its values, then the brand shape ripples outward spoke by spoke past it in the accent, springs into place with its corner dots popping and a pulse going out, while the plate tilts slowly
say: when the speaker says one option beats another on every count ('faster, cheaper, better on all five', 'it wins on every skill that matters'): cut in on the list, the brand shape pushes past on the word that names the win
